title: Saint-Frame Listener
text: Saint-Frame Listener opens a ring of preserved ears and triangulates the smallest lie in the route noise. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: It was built to hear testimony, not mercy.

defeatReward.text: Saint-Frame Listener is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
